annotations.title: Show, hide, lock or unlock a layer

description: Set visible, locked and/or printable on one layer (Ebene): at least one of the three. Pass layer_name or layer_id. Returns the layer state after the change, previous {visible, locked, printable}, item_count and changed. Warns when a layer with objects is hidden and when a layer is set to not print (its objects vanish from PDF exports). Unlocking is the fix when writing tools fail on objects of a locked layer.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

layer_id.description: Layer id from list_layers. Pass either layer_name or layer_id.

layer_name.description: Layer name (Ebene), exact, as list_layers returns it. Pass either layer_name or layer_id.

name: set_layer_visibility
title: Show, hide, lock or unlock a layer
